annotations.title: Employee, freelancer (ZZP) or own BV: what you keep

description: For one yearly budget (what a client or employer pays, excl. VAT) in the Netherlands in 2026: the net income as an employee (the budget covers salary and employer costs), as a freelancer (ZZP, with the entrepreneur deductions) and through your own BV (salary at least the customary wage, corporate tax and Box 2 on the dividend).

business_costs.description: Yearly business costs as ZZP or BV, euros. Default 5000.

bv_extra_costs.description: Extra yearly cost of running a BV (accountant, annual accounts), euros. Default 3000.

bv_salary.description: Salary the BV pays you, euros a year. Default the customary wage (or less if the BV can't pay it).

meets_hours_criterion.description: At least 1,225 hours a year in the business (for the ZZP deductions). Default true.

yearly_budget.description: Yearly amount the client or employer pays, excl. VAT, euros
